title: Among all cards illustrated by John Avon that are available in non-foil for
question: Among all cards illustrated by John Avon that are available in non-foil form, what percentage have a Japanese translation?

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_092" = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_093"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'John Avon' AND T1."XCL_004" LIKE '%paper%'
